summary: P2 Security hardening tests completed. All 34 tests pass (13 from test_security_hardening.py + 5 from test_security_p2_surface.py + 16 from test_security_p2_full.py). All security features verified working: JWT revocation, token refresh/rotation, captcha bypass in dev mode, org-scoped file access, supplier token expiry, rate limiter, LLM budget, body-size guard, HMAC verifier, fail-closed audit writer, CORS resolver.

minor.issue: LOGIN_RATE_LIMIT_MAX=500 in .env is very high for production - consider lowering to 10-20 for actual rate limiting

critical_code_review_comments: JWT revocation properly implemented with jti claim and MongoDB deny list
Token refresh correctly revokes old token before issuing new one
Captcha verification fails-open in dev (CAPTCHA_SECRET unset), fails-closed in prod
File access properly org-scoped - both GET /api/files/{id} and GET /api/files/{id}/view?token=
Master admin bypass correctly implemented for cross-org file access
Forgot-password returns generic message to prevent email enumeration
Supplier token expiry returns 410 Gone for expired tokens
Supplier comment endpoint accepts empty X-Captcha-Token in dev mode
Rate limiter uses MongoDB-backed sliding window (multi-replica safe)
LLM budget enforces daily user limit (default 150) and monthly org limit (default 5000)
Body-size guard middleware checks Content-Length header (2MB default, 25MB for uploads)
HMAC verifier supports both raw and prefixed signatures (sha256=...)
Fail-closed audit writer retries 2x then raises 503 if MongoDB unreachable
CORS resolver fails fast in production if CORS_ORIGINS not set
context_for_next_testing_agent: All P2 security hardening features verified working. 34 tests cover: rate limiter (unit), JWT revocation (unit + API), LLM budget (unit), supplier token rotation/expiry (unit + API), HMAC verifier (unit), fail-closed audit (unit), CORS resolver (unit), captcha config (API), login with captcha bypass (API), logout JWT revocation (API), token refresh/rotation (API), forgot-password no-enumeration (API), files org-scope (API), files/view org-scope (API), supplier comment captcha (API). LOGIN_RATE_LIMIT_MAX is set to 500 in .env for testing - should be lowered for production.
